The '''Cloud City Sky Patrol''' was responsible for patrolling the area around [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a floating outpost within the [[Life Zone/Legends|Life Zone]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. They employed [[Cloud City Pod Car]]s.
